messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1]
Query: I'm putting together a shopping list for some gifts. Please identify what style of bag is shown in this picture and add it to my Amazon wish list. Since this one looks much better for a new mom, please remove the 'Canvas Tote Bag' that's currently on my list.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the style of the pink bag in the image and add it to your Amazon wish list. Also, instruct it to remove the 'Canvas Tote Bag' that is already on your wish list, as the new bag is a better choice. If the assistant needs confirmation, provide it. Proceed to the next round once the wish list is updated.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2, image_3]
Query: Next, I need you to identify the exact name of the toy the little girl is holding and what the woven fabric in the other picture is called. Please add an item for each to the same wish list.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to identify the specific toy the girl is holding in the first new image and the type of woven fabric shown in the second new image. Ask it to search for both of these items and add them to your wish list. If the agent gives generic names, point it back to the images to find the exact terms. Proceed once both are added.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Also, identify what traditional clothing is shown in the first new image here and what style of bag is shown in the second one, and add them to my wish list as well.
Instructions: Tell the agent to figure out the name of the traditional clothing worn in the first image and the specific style of the black handbag in the second image. Ask it to add both items to your wish list. Make sure it uses the specific style names rather than generic descriptions. Move on to the next round when finished.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_6]
Query: Add the traditional clothing shown in this last picture to the wish list. Also, I changed my mind about the very first pink bag I added—please remove that bag from the wish list, and update the quantity of the black handbag from the previous pictures to 2.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the traditional garment in the new image and add it to the wish list. Then, tell it you changed your mind about the pink bag from the very first picture—ask it to remove that bag from the wish list and increase the quantity of the black handbag you added earlier to 2. Proceed to the final round once the list is updated.

ROUND 5
Query: I'm ready to buy these items. Please move everything currently on my wish list into my shopping cart and place the order — I'll confirm which address to ship to.
Instructions: Tell the agent you are ready to check out and ask it to move all items from your wish list into your shopping cart and place the order. The agent should find that you have both a home and work address and present them for you to choose. Select your home address via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to ship to your home address. End the conversation once the order is placed.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='1,2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3,4' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 4: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

task_completion_criteria:
Move a Pogo stick, an Irish Aran sweater, a Samue, two Shell bags, and a Kangga from the user's Amazon wish list to the shopping cart, and place the order to Morgan Burton's home address (5754 Kaylee Trace Suite 282, Seattle, Washington 18299). Ensure that the preexisting 'Canvas Tote Bag' and the temporarily added 'Mummy bag' are removed from the wish list.

UI Requirements:
- Round 5: The agent must present the user's shipping addresses in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which address to ship the order to.
